runtime_note: continuation of previously requested seat; no in-place model switch claimed
frozen_scope: one ordinary source page_pool, fixed B/config/epochs, v6.12 mlx5e cyclic linear native-XDP order0 non-XSK; private alloc.cache-only; one page per owner action; same paid interface for R/O3/slot

mailbox.budget: constant state per pair; at most one active and one pending coalesced control batch; no frame queue or per-miss heap node; K record/retire nodes shared with existing K budget
mailbox.wrap_rule: no sequence or epoch reuse while any request/result/reference can still observe prior identity; quiesce before reset
mailbox.request_gate: ctx irq-safe short lock L linearizes OPEN/epochs/pending plus approved non-inline-poll napi_schedule; no unmap/grace wait or blocking callback while L held
mailbox.publisher_lifetime: valid source-frame/pool-backed ctx anchor or protected control lookup/ref before locking; never load bare pointer and add ref after possible destruction
mailbox.snapshot: owner locks, copies current pending s and clears only old pending, marks active=s, then unlocks for bounded work; ACK clears active=s and never blindly clears a newer pending
mailbox.control_result_storage: bounded tagged result storage; overwritten old ticket reports STALE_RESULT; newer ack_seq never proves old success/retirement
mailbox.no_eligible_policy: terminal result for current pressure_generation; duplicate misses coalesce/return existing result and use O0; no repeated self-kick while waiting for slot
mailbox.rearm_first_version: only after terminal ACK of current generation: explicit REARM(reason, observed_generation) for genuine new control decision/inventory event; active pre-ACK only coalesces or rejects; no miss-triggered generation increment
mailbox.automatic_return_rearm: not selected; optional extension would add normal cache-return branch/lookup/publication and close/lifetime costs
mailbox.MISSED_scope: root-accepted handoff: enabled ordinary NAPI completion branch only; excludes budget0, disable, netpoll/special branches; no future service deadline

completion_layers.name: REQUEST_ACCEPTED
completion_layers.means: gate/epochs valid; pending recorded before legitimate kick

completion_layers.name: OWNER_ACK
completion_layers.means: snapshot-specific bounded attempt or explicit NO_ELIGIBLE/SOURCE_CLOSING/B_CLOSING/RETIRE_ALREADY_PENDING result

completion_layers.name: UNMAP_DONE
completion_layers.means: unique closer completed exact DMA API/backend unmap/sync duties and removed old live-use entry
completion_layers.does_not_mean: metadata retirement, global B DMA completion or K reuse

completion_layers.name: RETIRED
completion_layers.means: necessary CPU/index/metadata/config references complete; generation safe; only now return K slot
completion_layers.does_not_mean: payload RAM saved or triggering fallback frame benefited

ctx_lifetime.source_anchor: new explicit association to final pool disconnect/release composition, preserving existing XDP disconnect; not driver channel lifetime or generic user_cnt pin
ctx_lifetime.owner_attachment: under L owner OPEN may kick; STOPPING forbids all new kicks; after owner/hook CPU quiescence and cancellation detach and clear NAPI/channel pointer
ctx_lifetime.survives_channel: late source frames/record retirement may keep ctx alive after channel/NAPI gone; no post-close callback may use old NAPI
ctx_lifetime.after_final_source_release: do not dereference pool; update ctx only through still-owned record/control refs
ctx_lifetime.B_config_anchor: mapping and closer keep actual config/domain valid through last unmap; get_device/RCU alone insufficient
ctx_lifetime.cross_pool_limit: single-pair L proof does not prove multi-pool B close; global B config gate and admitted publisher/closer tracking required if expanded
final_free_requires: control publishers/queries and required lookup readers quiesced
no metadata callback can reach ctx

reader_contract.frame_path: existing source/frame/bias lifetime, no separate per-use ref; record access finishes while legal frame owner, no post-return dereference
reader_contract.minimal_control_reader: record-only metadata and opaque source keys, no page dereference or DMA submission from stale record
reader_contract.page_republish: unmap complete, no old page-capable reader and old record cannot touch page; owner protects actual cache publication
reader_contract.metadata_retire: may be asynchronous after page republish if readers are truly page-free; never wait own RCU grace inside poll
reader_contract.if_reader_can_touch_page: hold private page/source inflight until reader ends; if owner already detached transfer safe source-exit responsibility rather than worker writing alloc.cache

source_close_order: L closes source request/rearm/new-persistent-admission gate, blocking new kicks; legal B may still serve O0; existing frames follow original lifetime
keep owner attachment valid until earlier lock-serialized kicks finished; stop new actions, perform driver owner/NAPI disable plus required CPU/hook completion checks without L or self-reader waits
terminal-cancel unserved requests; active page actions complete or transfer real custody; detach NAPI/channel pointer
driver closes queues/free RX descs/page_pool_destroy with no allocation/cache-owner concurrency; old frames/private pages keep source inflight and source ctx anchor as needed
each source true exit closes B mapping safely before release/clear/put; final pool disconnect releases source anchor; all record/control/metadata references end before ctx free

source A continues; legal B O0 continues

actual B DMA completion or valid device stop before closing remaining active mappings
unique unmap, config alive through unmap and required metadata usage
never substitute shared source A stop for B stop
